overview: The Medford City Council considered resolutions on zero-based budgeting, charter school reimbursements, streaming service fee legislation, and preparing council chambers to reopen for public attendance. The Council also passed three ordinances on third reading and approved a $200,000 casino mitigation fund appropriation for fire ladder truck lease payments.

items.title: Donation Bins at Fellsway Plaza
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the administration contact Kimco Corporation regarding non-compliant donation collection bins at 630 Fellsway Plaza.

items.title: Zero-Based Budget Request
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the mayor present a zero-based budget for the upcoming fiscal year.

items.title: Quarterly SeeClickFix Reporting
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the administration provide quarterly data presentations on the SeeClickFix program.

items.title: Condolence Resolutions
items.summary: Passed resolutions expressing condolences to the families of Herbie Wells and Anthony Bonner.

items.title: Solar Carports Feasibility Study
items.summary: Approved a resolution directing the Energy and Environment Director to examine placing solar carports at city facilities to offset energy costs.

items.title: Fire Damage Update at 80-86 Salem Street
items.summary: Ruled out of order by the chair because the site is private property and no building permits have been requested.

items.title: Charter School Funding Reimbursements
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting state legislators advocate for a hold-harmless provision on charter school reimbursements for fiscal year 2022 and seek a permanent funding reform.

items.title: Streaming Service Fee Legislation
items.summary: Approved a resolution supporting state legislation assessing fees on streaming entertainment operators using public rights-of-way to help fund municipal budgets and public access media.

items.title: Reopening Council Chambers for Public Attendance
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the administration prepare City Council chambers to accommodate in-person public attendance following health guidelines.

items.title: Ordinances on Third Reading and Historical Commission Appropriation
items.summary: Passed third readings establishing a Behavioral Health Commission, regulating donation collection bins, and setting voting control, while also approving a $300,000 appropriation for the Historical Commission.

items.title: Eversource Winthrop Street Pipeline Update
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting Eversource representatives and city officials present a project update, schedule, and neighborhood communication plan for the Winthrop Street pipeline project.

items.title: Casino Mitigation Funding for Fire Ladder Truck Lease
items.summary: Approved a $200,000 appropriation from the Medford Casino Special Revenue Fund to cover lease payments for two new fire department ladder trucks.
